About Me

Curiosity in mind. Creativity in practice.

I'm Rassya, a student developer who learns by making — from software experiments to musical ideas.

I turn questions into small experiments, then keep refining them. Building helps me understand how things work and discover what they could become.

Code gives me a way to solve problems. Music shapes how I listen and create. My Javanese roots bring a sense of identity to both.
